name: migrate-complex-role-prompts
title: Story 6: migrate complex roles to modular Prompt Envelopes
description: Migrate story-init, scope-plan, implementer, delivery, and evaluator to modular Prompt Envelopes with complex-role budgets and real dispatch A/B evidence. Preserve delivery promises, scope-gap handling, implementer authorship, evaluator evidence, signatures, permissions, and Story-aware Task Context semantics established by Story 2. Budget overages are recorded as violations and do not block correctness-critical full review; no budget enforce decision is made here.
